% Invented deck: beamer's default theme declares no section page, and the
% document's own \AtBeginSection sets its frame right after each section it
% opens and, its optional argument empty, none after a starred one; a subsection
% opens no page, as no hook declares one. Nothing here derives from any private
% document.
\documentclass[aspectratio=169]{beamer}

\usetheme{default}
\AtBeginSection[]{\begin{frame}{Outline}The next part opens here.\end{frame}}

\fonts{
  dir = "fonts",
  body = "Open Sans",
}

\title{Sections Behind Hooks}
\author{Pat Placeholder}
\date{}

\begin{document}

\maketitle

\begin{frame}{Spokes}
  A wheel holds its spokes, and Section~\ref{sec:chains} drives it.
\end{frame}

\end{frame}

\section{Chains}\label{sec:chains}

\begin{frame}{Links}
  Chains follow wheels, as Section~\ref{sec:wheels} said.
\end{frame}

\end{frame}
